prompt: I'm starting a new data-export module from scratch in our Next.js app — it'll handle generating CSVs, kicking off a background job, and polling for status. How should I organise the files so it's easy for both me and Claude to work in?
assertions: Advises starting coarser / not pre-splitting the three phases into many files up front
Co-locates tightly coupled job lifecycle / polling
Recommends an abstraction (function/module) over bare file splits
Mentions a ~300-line threshold (or 'a few hundred lines') as the split trigger
